BrochureContent.Content:
Hooke & MacDonald are delighted to present 11 Shackleton Rise to the market, a beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home ideally located within the highly sought-after Shackleton Park development in Lucan. This modern and spacious property offers an excellent balance of style, comfort, and practicality, making it an ideal choice for families and first-time buyers alike.

Extending to approximately 110 sq.m / 1,184 sq.ft, the accommodation is bright, well-proportioned, and thoughtfully laid out. Upon entering, a welcoming hallway leads to a convenient guest WC and generous under-stairs storage. To the front of the property is a light-filled living room, creating a warm and inviting space to relax. To the rear, a spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area is finished to a high standard with sleek, modern fittings and ample storage. This impressive space is perfectly suited to both everyday living and entertaining, with doors opening onto a private west-facing rear garden—ideal for enjoying afternoon and evening sun.

Upstairs, there are three generously sized bedrooms, all with fitted wardrobes. The primary bedroom benefits from an ensuite bathroom, while a well-appointed family bathroom and hot press complete the accommodation at this level.
11 Shackleton Rise enjoys an enviable position within this mature and well-established development. Built by Cairn Homes, Shackleton Park is widely regarded as one of Lucan's most desirable residential addresses, offering a strong sense of community alongside beautifully maintained surroundings. Residents benefit from a wealth of local amenities, including excellent primary and secondary schools, shops, cafés, parks, and leisure facilities.

The area is exceptionally well connected, with frequent public transport links providing easy access to Dublin City Centre. The nearby N4, N7, and M50 road networks ensure seamless connectivity to the wider city and beyond, while Dublin Airport is also within easy reach.
This is a superb opportunity to acquire a turn-key home in a prime location, with the added benefit of a west-facing garden, offering the perfect combination of modern living and outdoor enjoyment.
